item.title: Solved: MySQL JDBC Driver 5.1.33 Time Zone Issue – 27 Ways to Fix It
item.description: When running a Java web application on Tomcat with MySQL as the backend, it’s common to encounter time zone issues, especially after upgrading to newer versions of the MySQL JDBC driver. One particularly frustrating issue that arises with MySQL 5.1.33 and higher versions is the “server timezone value ‘UTC’ is unrecognized” error. This can disrupt your application’s database connectivity, and resolving it requires a deep dive into MySQL’s timezone configurations.
